How many people are sitting between J and R when counting from the right of J?
questions.solution:
Given: H, I, J, P, Q, R and S are seated around a round table facing the centre

1) P sits third to the left of Q.

2) R sits second to the left of S.

3) Q is an immediate neighbour of both J and R.

4) H is not an immediate neighbour of P.

After positioning all only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
If + means −, − means ×, × means ÷ and ÷ means +, then what will come in place of - sign (?) in the following equation?

 

26 + 14 − 2 ÷ 56 × 7 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 26 + 14 − 2 ÷ 56 × 7 = ? 

Logic: Operators interchanged as follows:

**+ → −, ****− → ×, ****× → ÷, ****÷ → +**

Now, 26 **−** 14 **×** 2 **+** 56 **÷** 7

⇒ 26 − (14 × 2) + (56 ÷ 7)

⇒ 26 − 28 + 8 = 6

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. It is assumed that the information given in the statements is true, even if it differs from generally known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements. Statements:

 
• All bears are ants.
 
• No bear is a horse.

Conclusions:

 
• (I) No ant is a horse.
 
• (II) No horse is a bear.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All bears are ants.

No bear is a horse.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f780913222768c35b8da0353cd312389c880afa1017a4fc712d56b267c2681f.png] 

Conclusions:

**(I) No ant is a horse:**

Since only a part* of the Ants (the part that is Bears) is definitely separate from Horses, the remaining part of the Ants (Ants that are *not* Bears) might or might not be Horses.

Therefore, the conclusion "No ant is a horse" does not logically follow.

Conclusion (I) follows.

**(II) No horse is a bear:**

 

Since the statement "No bear is a horse" is true, its converse, "No horse is a bear," must also be true.

Therefore, the conclusion "No horse is a bear" **logically follows**.

So, **Only conclusion (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
